Improved \u2014 both named bracket defects addressed.

Defect 1 (bracket spiking above the tabletop): every extruded bracket vertex is now clamped into the plate's analytic local box (0.100 x 0.130 x 0.030 m) by clampToPlate(), so no bracket geometry can exist above the slab underside at y = 0.705 m no matter what ExtrudeGeometry does with a 0.005 m sliver outline. The local box is derived from the outline plus a one-off rectangular probe that measures whether kit.extrude re-centres in x/y/z, so the top arris seats at exactly 0.705 m without assuming a convention.

Defect 1 (far-panel transform): the far pair is no longer the deep end of a three-link mirror chain (bracket -> mirror z -> mirror x -> mirror z), which was the suspect stacked-negative-scale transform. 'bracket-far-front' is authored directly at x = +0.652 - 0.05 with rotation [0, PI, 0] so its inboard leg points towards -x; seating uses the same measured bracketY / bracketFaceX numbers as the near plate. Spec position for the near plate still resolves to [-0.602, 0.640, 0.200], matching the spec's [-0.6, 0.64, 0.2].

Defect 2 (fake apron band): the same clamp caps each plate at 0.100 m inboard of its own panel, so the four plates occupy only x in [-0.652, -0.552] and [0.552, 0.652] and the middle ~1.10 m of the underside is empty geometry-free space. Four independent, non-merged extrude meshes, each with its own geometry, at x = \u00b10.650 (face sunk 0.002 m per the bolted overlap), z = \u00b10.20, 0.13 m vertical leg / 0.10 m horizontal leg / 0.03 m wide.

Repetition bookkeeping: 'bracket-fb' is still a kit.mirror(..., 'z') on each panel; 'bracket-lr' is now expressed by the explicitly authored, yaw-flipped far plate instead of an x-mirror, because an x-mirror taken off the same authored plate collides on the generated id 'bracket-mirror' and only one clone survives. Its id 'bracket-far-front' is a spec id (detailInventory / bracket localFeatures), so defects on it remain attributable.

Left alone deliberately: slab and panel geometry, the inverted slab-on-panel restOn with the slab centre pinned at 0.7125, the panel-pair x-mirror, the foot-pad geometry and its 0.0005 m adhesive overlap, and the flat plastic stand-in materials.
